Codex amd64 musl-package archive checksum: tag plus its verified sha256 moves with the release via github-release-attachments (hosted-supported digest updating, no post-upgrade commands). Values stay in tag form so getDigest requests releases/tags/rust-vX.Y.Z.

shellcheck amd64 tar.xz checksum: tag plus its recorded sha256 moves with the release via github-release-attachments. Upstream publishes no checksums file, so the SHAs are recorded manually (NOTE(shellcheck)); Renovate moves the tags and the SHAs follow via the attachment digest.

constraints.bun must move in the same PR as BUN_VERSION, or that PR fails its own tripwire test.

packageRules.description: Codex numeric version via github-releases: rust-v tags map to CODEX_VERSION, only stable numeric releases, grouped so version and both archive checksums move in one update.
Codex tag-form archive checksums via github-release-attachments stay on rust-v tags so getDigest requests releases/tags/rust-vX.Y.Z; only stable tags, grouped with the numeric version update.
yq numeric version via github-releases: vX.Y.Z tags map to YQ_VERSION, only stable numeric releases, grouped so version and both binary checksums move in one update.
yq tag-form binary checksums via github-release-attachments stay on vX.Y.Z tags so getDigest requests releases/tags/vX.Y.Z; only stable tags, grouped with the numeric version update.
uv numeric version via github-releases: plain X.Y.Z tags map to UV_VERSION, only stable numeric releases, grouped so version and both tarball checksums move in one update.
uv tag-form tarball checksums via github-release-attachments stay on plain X.Y.Z tags so getDigest requests releases/tags/X.Y.Z; only stable tags, grouped with the numeric version update.
promtool numeric version via github-releases: vX.Y.Z tags map to PROMTOOL_VERSION, only stable numeric releases, grouped so version and both tarball checksums move in one update.
promtool tag-form tarball checksums via github-release-attachments stay on vX.Y.Z tags so getDigest requests releases/tags/vX.Y.Z; only stable tags, grouped with the numeric version update.
tofu numeric version via github-releases: vX.Y.Z tags map to TOFU_VERSION, only stable numeric releases, grouped so version and both zip checksums move in one update.
tofu tag-form zip checksums via github-release-attachments stay on vX.Y.Z tags so getDigest requests releases/tags/vX.Y.Z; only stable tags, grouped with the numeric version update.
kubeconform numeric version via github-releases: vX.Y.Z tags map to KUBECONFORM_VERSION, only stable numeric releases, grouped so version and both tarball checksums move in one update.
kubeconform tag-form tarball checksums via github-release-attachments stay on vX.Y.Z tags so getDigest requests releases/tags/vX.Y.Z; only stable tags, grouped with the numeric version update.

kubectl numeric version via github-releases: vX.Y.Z tags map to KUBECTL_VERSION, only stable numeric releases. The binary is fetched from dl.k8s.io (no release attachment), so per-arch SHAs follow manually (NOTE(kubectl) in tool-versions.env) with the image-build sha256sum -c as the fail-closed backstop.
actionlint numeric version via github-releases: vX.Y.Z tags map to ACTIONLINT_VERSION, only stable numeric releases, grouped so version and both tarball checksums move in one update.
actionlint tag-form tarball checksums via github-release-attachments stay on vX.Y.Z tags so getDigest requests releases/tags/vX.Y.Z; only stable tags, grouped with the numeric version update.
shellcheck numeric version via github-releases: vX.Y.Z tags map to SHELLCHECK_VERSION, only stable numeric releases, grouped so version and both tar.xz checksums move in one update.
shellcheck tag-form tar.xz checksums via github-release-attachments stay on vX.Y.Z tags so getDigest requests releases/tags/vX.Y.Z; only stable tags, grouped with the numeric version update.
zizmor numeric version via github-releases: vX.Y.Z tags map to ZIZMOR_VERSION, only stable numeric releases. Installed via uvx from PyPI (verified by uv), so no per-arch SHA is pinned.
ruff numeric version via github-releases: vX.Y.Z tags map to RUFF_VERSION, only stable numeric releases. Installed via uvx from PyPI (verified by uv), so no per-arch SHA is pinned.

Node LTS via node-version default versioning (node): the datasource marks only LTS lines stable from the release schedule, so no allowedVersions regex is needed; per-arch tarball SHAs in tool-versions.env are updated manually alongside NODE_VERSION.
oven-sh/bun tags releases as bun-v1.2.3, which github-releases cannot parse as semver.
Disable built-in bun tool-constraint updates; constraints.bun moves with BUN_VERSION via the custom regex manager.
Keep the worker JDK on Temurin 21.
Keep the second worker JDK on Temurin 25.
